mapper.delete: DELETE from sys_role_module where id in (select old.mrId from (select id, CONCAT(MODULE_ID, ',', IFNULL(RESOURCE_ID, '')) mrId from sys_role_module where ROLE_ID = #{id} and MODULE_ID is not null) source RIGHT JOIN (select srm.id, CONCAT(MODULE_ID, ',', IFNULL(RESOURCE_ID, '')) mrId from (select r.* from sys_role r RIGHT JOIN (select TENANT_ID from sys_tenant_role where ROLE_ID = #{id}) t on t.TENANT_ID = r.TENANT_ID) tr INNER JOIN sys_role_module srm on tr.id = srm.ROLE_ID where MODULE_ID is not null) old on source.mrId = old.mrId where source.id is null);

DELETE from sys_role_module where id in (select old.mrId from (select id, CONCAT(MODULE_ID, ',', IFNULL(RESOURCE_ID, '')) mrId from sys_role_module where ROLE_ID = #{roleId} and MODULE_ID is not null) source RIGHT JOIN (select srm.id, CONCAT(MODULE_ID, ',', IFNULL(RESOURCE_ID, '')) mrId from sys_role r INNER JOIN sys_role_module srm on r.id = srm.ROLE_ID where MODULE_ID is not null and r.TENANT_ID = #{id}) old on source.mrId = old.mrId where source.id is null);
